instruction: Look at plate_100x60x12.step. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Define rectangular stock with 2 mm extension on all X/Y sides and 1 mm extension above Z. Place the Job origin at the stock top-face center. Use T1 to create a Face operation targeting final top Z=12.000 mm with S6000 rpm and F800 mm/min. Post using linuxcnc or grbl and. Tool definition: T1 is a 16 mm face mill for the Face operation, S6000 rpm, F800 mm/min. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-1.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
